Around [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] orchestrated an '''attack''' on the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Fortitude (Valor-class)|''Fortitude'']], a diplomatic vessel which served as the meeting place for the members of the [[Rift Alliance]] separatist group. The members of the Rift Alliance were rescued by the newly-christened [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TOR:AAoO" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Aftermath==
Following the attack, Imperial ambassador and attache to Coruscant [[Sammel Yane]] released a short statement, claiming the Empire had no operations in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]], implying the attackers led by the Sith [[Arrax (Sith)|Arrax]] were in fact "rogue elements", for which the Empire could not be held accountable.<ref name="TOR:GNN" />
